offering_description.value: Corebridge sells annuities and life insurance to individuals and provides workplace retirement plans to employers and their employees. It also helps institutional customers fund pension obligations and manage stable-value investments. Its insurance subsidiaries issue the contracts, and financial intermediaries and workplace advisers distribute most retail and workplace offerings.

primary_products.value: Individual fixed, indexed and variable annuities; workplace retirement annuities and investment options; term and permanent life insurance; pension risk transfer and structured settlement annuities; stable-value contracts and guaranteed investment contracts

primary_services.value: Workplace retirement plan administration and recordkeeping; retirement planning and investment advice

customer_segment.value: B2C: Individuals saving for retirement, retirees seeking income and life insurance buyers; B2B: Private employers, nonprofits, pension plan sponsors, stable-value fund managers and financial institutions; B2G: Public school districts, public colleges, and state and local government employers

end_markets.value: Personal retirement savings and income; workplace retirement benefits; individual life insurance; institutional pension and stable-value markets

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: Life insurance premiums and investment spreads on annuities and institutional funding contracts; commissions or management fees: Asset-based charges on variable annuities and managed retirement accounts; service fees: Workplace retirement plan administration and recordkeeping
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Invests premiums and deposits and issues insurance, annuity and funding contracts to individuals, employers and institutions; service provider: Uses employer and participant records to administer workplace retirement plans and advise participants

geography_served.value: US national: Customers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Individual annuities, workplace retirement plans, life insurance and institutional risk transfer and funding products

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Broker-dealers, banks and independent marketing organizations; agents / brokers: Independent insurance agents, benefits brokers and pension consultants; direct sales: Workplace retirement advisers and sales teams serving employers and institutional customers
distribution_channels.category: partners / resellers; agents / brokers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance departments license insurers, and the SEC and FINRA oversee applicable securities activities.
